verdict.rationale: The API exposes the core model capabilities a chat UI offers: thinking and non-thinking modes, multimodal vision models, tool calls, JSON output and streaming, through OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible formats. Nothing in the evidence states or shows that the API matches the UI feature for feature. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, evidence for UI features like web search, file/document upload and conversation history over the API, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
